subject.title: feat: discover OpenCode and Pi sessions on paired nodes

question: Should OpenClaw consume project-local Pi session settings only when Pi’s own saved, temporary, or default project-trust decision permits them?
rationale: The catalog can list and read transcripts through paired nodes, so choosing whether checkout-controlled settings may redirect discovery is a product security boundary rather than a routine implementation detail.

options.title: Mirror Pi Trust
options.body: Apply Pi’s project-trust decision before loading project settings and otherwise fall back to global settings.

options.title: Global Settings Only
options.body: Ignore project-local Pi settings for daemon discovery, reducing ambient project influence at the cost of incomplete parity.

options.title: Broader OpenClaw Discovery
options.body: Allow project settings regardless of Pi trust and explicitly document that OpenClaw uses a broader transcript-discovery boundary.

recommendation.title: Mirror Pi Trust
recommendation.body: Apply Pi’s project-trust decision before loading project settings and otherwise fall back to global settings.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature sponsor and branch implementer is the best available owner to present the intended boundary for maintainer confirmation.
